title: Economic Choices and Complete Argumentative Essay
prompt: Some people believe that governments should prioritise economic growth above all other goals, even if this means accepting higher levels of inequality and environmental damage. Others argue that economic progress should be balanced with social fairness and environmental protection. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请针对题目中的两种观点进行讨论，并明确给出你自己的立场。建议先分别阐述双方理由，再结合具体例子（如教育、医疗、环境政策）说明你的看法。注意段落清晰、论证充分，字数不少于250词。
